item.title: Week 10: Commanders at Giants
item.description: Thu 11/12 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: NYG -1.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model NYG 67% vs. market 53% | On paper the Giants have the edge, led by their downfield passing: they rank 6th in EPA per deep attempt (+0.54), against Washington's defense at 19th (+0.43 allowed). Washington's best counter is its tackling, with its defense ranking 4th in broken tackles per touch (10.1%) while the Giants rank 32nd (3.2%). Jayden Daniels ranks 19th of 31 in EPA per dropback, but the data has no quarterback rank for the Giants, so there is no direct comparison. Malik Nabers, who draws 31% of Giants targets and 35% of air yards (WOPR 0.66, 14th of 108), is the x-factor against a Washington pass defense ranked 16th. The model favors the Giants at 67%, driven mainly by rushing matchup (2.1 points) and home field (1.7 points).
